nsign.shortDescription: A document verification and signing ecosystem for business workflows.
nsign.description: I developed interface screens for Nsign: a centralized workspace for document approval, form management, and subscription flows. The focus was on clear user journeys, resilient screen states, and working efficiently with large data sets.
nsign.contribution: Built the approval-module interface, improved status navigation and document flow clarity, and aligned the screens around a consistent product language. I worked closely with designers and analysts to speed up release cycles and reduce validation issues.

harbour-space.shortDescription: A learning platform for programs, events, and academic discovery.
harbour-space.description: I contributed to Harbour Space’s product experience: program pages, event catalogs, participation flows, and responsive layouts across device sizes. The key challenge was balancing dense information with straightforward and focused user journeys.
harbour-space.contribution: Updated the structure of program pages, refined navigation between courses and events, and improved presentation quality across breakpoints. I consolidated common UI patterns and reduced duplicated logic across the product.

seafood-shop.shortDescription: An online seafood storefront with catalog, cart, and checkout flows.
seafood-shop.description: I worked on the seafood shop storefront: product catalog, product details, cart state, and checkout UX. The focus was to keep the shopping experience fast, legible, and lightweight without overwhelming users with visual clutter.
seafood-shop.contribution: Designed and implemented the catalog and cart experience, stabilised responsive layouts, and refined UI states to make ordering more comfortable and understandable on different screen sizes.

interlabs.shortDescription: A platform for internal data workflows and team analytics panels.
interlabs.description: I contributed to the Interlabs product experience for operational and analytical workflows: dashboard states, filters, and working sets of data. The challenge was making complex information readable without sacrificing clarity or speed.
interlabs.contribution: Unified common interface patterns into a cleaner component system, improved filter behaviour and loading states, and reduced maintenance cost across the product while accelerating future feature delivery.
